== Biography ==
'''Katherine Glasgow''' lived in the parish of Stevenston, Ayrshire, and was married to [[Weir-4172|Thomas Weir]]. The Glasgow Commissary Court calendar identifies her as Thomas's spouse and records her testament on 9 May 1605, so she died before that date.<ref name="Testament">Francis J. Grant, ed., ''The Commissariot Record of Glasgow: Register of Testaments, 1547-1800'' (Edinburgh, 1901), [https://archive.org/details/scottishrecordso07scotuoft/page/196/mode/1up p. 196], entry for Katherine Glasgow; underlying register NRS CC9/7/4.</ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-3921]] is assessed at 47% (possible). Inherited uncertain attachment to James Glasgow younger-3921; Katherine’s Stevenston testament names no parent. The selected younger James belongs to the same Stevenston/Corsankell setting and has a feasible generation for Katherine. This is a specific local-family hypothesis rather than a proved daughter clause.

Possible fatherhood; the testament’s Glencairn/local network supports geography but does not name a Glasgow parent.

Next useful test: Compare Katherine’s creditors, holdings and Weir family with the Corsankell records.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-1495 Inherited father attachment: Glasgow-1495 to Glasgow-3921; retained public historical profile and individually stated evidence limits]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.


Katherine's birth about 1580 is an unsourced estimate and remains uncertain. The testament calendar does not name her parents or children.

[[Glasgow-3921|James Glasgow younger of Corsankell]] is retained only as an uncertain father because the generation and Stevenston locality are compatible; no reviewed record states the relationship. WikiTree may flag Katherine's estimated 1580 birth as occurring after James's death. This is not a chronological conflict: 9 February 1571 is the last date on which James is documented alive, and his death field is marked “after,” not as an exact death date.

The indexed record establishes Katherine's spouse, parish and death boundary. It does not support the former speculative narrative about an insolvent inventory, unidentified administrators, “Sir Dafnes,” Stafford or guardianship. The underlying Glasgow Commissary Court reference CC9/7/4 is retained, but those interpretations should not be restored without verified images and a reliable transcription.

The date 9 May 1605 is the testament date, not a marriage date. Stevenston is in Ayrshire, not Lanarkshire.
